mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary tightening cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real yields fall.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity and earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of INDPRO > 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals improving labor market conditions and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of PAYEMS > 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the S&P CoreLogic Home Price Index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals improving housing market conditions and wealth effects, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of HOUST > 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and growth slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
